# Jashandeep Singh — Video Editor

## About
Jashandeep Singh is a professional video editor based in India, available worldwide for remote projects.
He specialises in high-retention editing, commercial storytelling, and creative post-production using DaVinci Resolve.

## Services
- **Commercial Video Editing** — cinematic cuts for brands, product launches, and campaigns
- **YouTube & Short-Form Editing** — high-retention edits optimised for watch time and audience growth
- **DaVinci Resolve Colour Grading** — ACES and node-based colour pipelines
- **Motion Graphics & VFX** — title sequences, transitions, and visual effects
- **Documentary & Long-Form Editing** — narrative structure, pacing, and story arc refinement

## Stats

- Clients in India, UAE, USA, UK, and Canada
